title: Bleeding from the back passage, an embarrassed patient and her support worker; healthcare assistant as chaperone; examination deferred
description: Fictional synthetic consultation for Module 3 testing; not a real patient record or medical advice.

design.opening: the support worker starts, because the patient is too embarrassed to say why she is here
partial_or_uncertain: when the bleeding started: 'a week, maybe two, I wasn't looking'
the patient cannot name her iron tablets or her water tablet
the doctor never states a diagnosis: he says he does not want to guess and offers possibilities in passing only
no examination is done today, the patient asks to wait
facts: a lump near the back passage, discomfort when sitting for about a week, bright red blood on the paper
no black stools, severe pain, dizziness, fever, weight loss, change in bowel habit
low blood count for years, heart failure
hernia operation last spring, sister had breast cancer, lives with partner and grandchild
plan: blood count Thursday at 10, a camera test of the bowel, review in four weeks, return if bleeding heavier or faint
